author: Laurie McNamara
title: Super Food Broccoli Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup kohlrabi (peeled and thinly sliced into matchsticks (julienned))
1 cup carrots (peeled and thinly sliced into matchsticks (julienned))
instructions_list: In a large bowl, measure and add the prepped broccoli stems, florets, napa cabbage, kale, brussels sprouts, purple cabbage, kohlrabi and carrots.
Toss well to combine. See the recipe card below this one for how to make it into a salad.
description: Say goodbye to bagged, pre-shredded slaw with this incredible Super Food Broccoli Slaw recipe! A low calorie, nutrient dense mix of healthy and crunchy veggies like broccoli stems and florets, napa cabbage, chopped kale, purple cabbage, thinly sliced brussels spouts, matchstick carrots and kohlrabi. Excellent as a base for a salad, a filling for wraps or topping on tacos! Yields 12 cups.
